metadata.name: Colors
metadata.description: Guides > Colors and theming. How colors.json feeds every platform, how `jui build` registers colours automatically, and how a theme is switched at runtime. Seven numbered sections: the themed palette shape (modes / fallback_mode / systemModeMapping, flat-to-themed migration), automatic extraction (which attributes are scanned, how a generated name is derived from brightness + dominant channel, matching an existing hex to its key, where the rewrite lands, defined_colors.json for unknown names), per-platform output (ColorManager.swift / .kt / .ts plus theme.css with @theme and :root[data-theme]), runtime switching (systemModeMapping, setMode, followSystemMode, mutableStateOf / observable / useSyncExternalStore), static token classes vs bound colours resolved through ColorManager.resolveColor, the mode-complete rule that decides whether a name can be a theme variable, and the sharp edges (promote generated names, a hex matching a token IS that token, alpha-first hex, inline styles need a re-render). ~8-min read.

uiVariables.description: Three closing cards: localization guide, style attributes, ReactJsonUI.

notes: 2026-07-28 — New page. The site documented strings.json (guides/localization) but had no equivalent for colours, while the palette had grown a themed schema, automatic extraction and a per-mode theme.css.

Section 2 was written from a measured probe rather than from reading alone: a temporary layout carrying #123456 and #FE4A49 was built, which produced `dark_cyan` / `medium_red` in the distributed tree, added them to the distributed palette in the light mode only, and emitted the mode-complete warning for both. The probe was removed afterwards and the tree rebuilt clean.

The same run showed authored hexes matching existing entries (#0B1220 / #475467 / #64748B) being rewritten to ink / ink_muted / ink_subtle in the distributed layouts — the observation behind the 'a hex that matches a token IS that token' warning in section 7.

Canonical sources: rjui_tools/lib/core/resources/color_manager.rb (schema, extraction, key generation, ColorManager + theme.css emission), the sjui / kjui copies of the same class for the Swift and Kotlin emitters, rjui_tools/lib/react/tailwind_mapper.rb (mode-complete gating and the off-palette warning), the generated src/generated/ColorManager.ts (color / resolveColor / setMode / followSystemMode), and jui_tools/jui_cli/commands/build_cmd.py (Resources distribution).
resolveColor landed 2026-07-28 (report: web-inline-color-token-resolution); before it, bound colours were passed through raw on web while iOS and Android already resolved them by name.
